visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outdoor street scene. A young Asian woman with long brown hair, wearing a white cropped cardigan and brown pants, holds a beige vivo X300 Pro smartphone. She gestures with her right hand while pointing at the large circular camera module on the back of the device. The background is a busy city street with traffic and buildings. (2) Close-up on the phone's rear camera. The woman's hands hold the device, highlighting the ZEISS logo and the four lenses inside the circular glass. The lighting is bright and natural. The phone is a matte beige color with a metallic rim. (3) Macro CGI animation of the internal hardware. Multiple layers of electronic chips rise and stack, labeled VS1, V3+, and MediaTek Dimensity 9500. Blue light pulses through the circuits against a dark, high-tech background. (4) Demonstration of camera zoom. The phone screen displays a purple flower amidst green leaves. The woman's finger slides the zoom bar from 1x to 30x. The image remains sharp. Next, it shows a pigeon on gray pavement, photographed clearly from a distance. (5) Outdoor motion shots. The woman stands on a sidewalk, making a peace sign. She jumps and turns in slow motion, her hair flying through the air. The camera captures her full body and upper body against the urban backdrop. (6) Studio setting demonstration. The woman sits at a wooden table in front of a gray brick wall. A stuffed otter and pillows are on the sofa behind her. She holds the phone and demonstrates UI features like the volume slider, the Atomic Island, and file sharing with an iPhone. (7) Closing scene. The woman stands in the studio holding the phone, smiling at the camera. She points down toward a link as a final call to action. The lighting is warm and professional studio style.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced female narration begins with high energy and friendly tone. Bright, upbeat acoustic pop music with acoustic guitar strumming and a light drum beat plays in the background. Short whoosh sound effects punctuate visual cuts and transitions. (2) Narration continues describing tech specs and internal hardware. Voice is clear and enunciated with moderate conversational loudness. Music remains consistent. A ding sound effect plays when specific features or chips are highlighted on the screen. (3) Tone shifts slightly as the speaker discusses professional photography capabilities. Tempo of narration is brisk but organized. Background music volume ducks slightly under the voice. Several shutter click sound effects are heard corresponding to photographic captures. (4) A digital transition SFX leads into the studio section. The voice becomes more explanatory but maintains high arousal. System sound effects like pop or UI clicks are audible as she navigates the phone's interface elements. (5) Closing remarks with a very positive and enthusiastic emotional valence. Music swells slightly in volume toward the end. Final call to action is delivered with strong vocal command and clarity before a hard cut silence.
